0x001CE620.layout: Road+38 is a52-byte-stride record-array pointer; road+48 points to12-byte XYZ vertices. This is separate from existing96-byte GeorgeGoalRoadEntry through road+3C. Selected record u16+8/+C supply the primary two vertex runs; +A/+E supply the mode quad. Count is caller-supplied signed16, with current/next run steps narrowed to low8 bits for addressing.
0x001CE620.source_reuse: The complete side expression/tiny-edge comparison is present in published spatial_queries.c polygon_contains: dz=following.z-current.z; negative_dx=current.x-following.x; strict tiny interval; reload point/current XZ; x_product+z_product; sticky side across skipped edges. Reuse that ordinary expression shape, not its variable vertex count, transforms, height±2 predicate or return semantics. No existing shared helper/header refactor is authorized yet.
0x001CE620.ordering: Count<=1 returns initialFPR12 with outputs untouched. Otherwise build first quad as scalar XYZ loads/stores, fixed four-edge loop with sticky side initialized0 for each quad. A positive side exits the edge loop; only strict side<budget accepts. If mode is nonNULL, rebuild the second quad from fresh road+38/+48 and original base fields, repeat the edge loop, and store mode=(side<=0). Full SW mode at1CEA3C precedes required SB current index at1CEA40 and budget update. Next iteration reloads road+38 after both visible stores.
0x001CE620.special_paths: No candidate leaves both outputs untouched; they may remain indeterminate in callers that did not initialize them. NULL mode skips the entire second quad. No height predicate or unconditional output clearing. Fixed divisor4 is nonzero; retain actual original guard geometry without inventing a format guard.

0x001CEA80.layout: Header+4 contains existing bounds; header+2C contains road pointer. Road u16+6 supplies fallback count; road+24 a u32 tagged array; +30 mutable cell storage base; +34 published registry index; +38 record base; +48 vertex base. A returned registry row word+4 is a byte offset into road+30. Cell u16+0 is list count, +4/+8 are mutable two-stage lookup pointers, u8+C is lazy flag, +10 starts self-relative u16 storage. These accesses do not establish an original class, overall allocation, table capacity or asset-format bounds.
0x001CEA80.source_reuse: Execute actual published bounds/provider lookup and registry source. Cast the wrapped numeric cell key to const void* for the existing registry API: it compares integer pointer bits and never dereferences this key. Reuse unchanged licensed ceilf and fptoui, including actual __unpack_f source dependency. A host float-to-integer cast would fail negative/out-of-range behavior and is not an acceptable substitute.
0x001CEA80.grid_key: Capture local X/Z=point-header minimum before ceilf. Read fresh bounds X upper/lower for ceilf difference. Convert real ceilf return with fptoui, then ceil integer quotient by40 using quotient+nonzero remainder. Convert captured localX and localZ separately with fptoui and unsigned-divide40. Cellkey=column+row*columns with original low32 wrap. No invented coordinate or grid-capacity guard.
0x001CEA80.lazy_cell_order: Read count u16+0 BEFORE visible writes. SW(cell+10) to cell+4, SB1 to cell+C, then SW(cell+10+2*(capturedcount+1)) to cell+8. Already initialized cells retain their current pointers. Fresh cellcount/list pointer reloads are retained after each subquery.
0x001CEA80.candidate_addressing: First u16 from cell+4 list is a BYTE offset added directly to cell+8; the second u16 is the record index. Compute candidate pointer with the full unsigned u16*52; separately narrow the C620 argument to signed16. C620 count is candidate u8+5 in the JAL delay. This unsigned-pointer/signed-argument distinction is not simplified into one signed address.
0x001CEA80.road_output_and_fallback: Every nonNULL cell publishes the initial road at1CECA0 after its loop, including count0 and NULL-best-result cases. If no cell result, traverse fresh road u16+6/tagged array+24; cache word&7FFF0000, including a NULL resolver result, initially mask0FFFFFFF. Call published1CCA28 only when mask changes, then reload current tagged array/word and use signedlow16 index. On strict improved side, update bestrecord/budget then publish resolved road at1CED54. Reload original-road count/tagged pointers after stores/calls. Early missing header/road or all no-candidate paths do not initialize mode/vertex.
0x001CEA80.alias_order: Required road output can alias point/header/cell/arrays; optional fullword mode and byte vertex may alias each other or road record fields. Preserve captured versus fresh loads, output store sequence and repeated best-budget comparisons. Cell roadout can change even when the final return is NULL.
